mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token, platform, login_time, expire_time, status FROM user_token WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, token, platform, login_time, expire_time, status FROM user_token WHERE token = #{token}
SELECT id, user_id, token, platform, login_time, expire_time, status FROM user_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY login_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_token(user_id, token, platform, login_time, expire_time, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{token}, #{platform}, #{loginTime}, #{expireTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_token SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_token SET status = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
